verdict.rationale: The evidence points to customizable fields but never to workflow statuses. Notion's docs reference databases and page 'property changes' (configurable fields), and community users praise its database functionality as 'incredibly flexible and configurable' and use it as a project/issue tracker sitting between JIRA-style tools and wikis. No first-party documentation describes defining custom field types or configuring workflow status options, and one user reports hitting limits when using it as a tracker. Missing for 10: explicit docs on custom property/field types, documented customizable workflow status options and groups, hands-on corroboration of tailoring a status workflow to a team process.
